<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>sn_disco_certmgmt.GenerateCSRProbeInvoker</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>GenerateCSRProbeInvoker</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var GenerateCSRProbeInvoker = Class.create();
GenerateCSRProbeInvoker.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {
        this.certificateRequestAutomatedFlow = new CertificateRequestAutomatedFlow();
    },

	sendProbe: function(parameterMap) {
		parameterMap["used_by_runbook"] = "true";
		parameterMap["keySize"] = gs.getProperty('sn_disco_certmgmt.private_key_size', 2048);

		parameterMap["skip_sensor"] = "false";
		parameterMap["probe"] = "a31575e4ff6d2210ef03fa54fc4fd9d6";
		parameterMap["used_by_discovery"] = "true";
		parameterMap["probe_name"] = "Probe - Generate CSR";
		parameterMap["certificate_request_type"] = "renew";

		var midId = this.getMid("Certificate Inventory and Management", "GenerateCSR", parameterMap['sys_domain']);
		if(midId == null) {
            this.addWorkNoteAndUpdateTask(parameterMap["renewal_task_id"]);
		} else {
            var probe = new ProbeInvoker();
            probe.sendProbe(midId, 'GenerateCSRProbe', parameterMap);
            this.certificateRequestAutomatedFlow.updateCertTaskWorkNotes(parameterMap["renewal_task_id"], gs.getMessage('starting_csr_generation', midId));
		}
	},

	addWorkNoteAndUpdateTask: function(taskId) {
		var error = gs.getMessage("unable_to_find_mid_to_generate_csr");
		var renewTaskgr = new GlideRecord('sn_disco_certmgmt_renew_task');
		renewTaskgr.get(taskId);
        this.certificateRequestAutomatedFlow.updateCertTaskWorkNotes(taskId, error);
		renewTaskgr.setValue('state', 3);
		renewTaskgr.update();
		throw new Error(error);
	},

	invokeDeletePrivateKeyProbe: function(privateKeyReferenceMap) {
		var parameters = {};
		parameters["used_by_runbook"] = "true";
		parameters["skip_sensor"] = "false";
		parameters["probe"] = "1f7d2b4c47d6a21032939b40706d4394";
		parameters["used_by_discovery"] = "true";
		parameters["probe_name"] = "DeletePrivateKeysProbe";
		parameters["private_key_reference_map"] = JSON.stringify(privateKeyReferenceMap);
		var midId = this.getMid("Certificate Inventory and Management", "GenerateCSR");
		if(midId == null) {
			gs.error("Unable to find a mid server to invoke DeletePrivateKeysProbe");
		} else {
            var probe = new ProbeInvoker();
            probe.sendProbe(midId, 'DeletePrivateKeysProbe', parameters);
		}
	},

	getMid: function(app, capability, sysDomain) {
        new global.CSRDecodeCertificateAjax().setDomainId(sysDomain);
        var eccApp = new GlideRecord("ecc_agent_application");
        eccApp.get("name", app);
        if(gs.nil(eccApp)) {
            return null;
        }

        var eccCapability = new GlideRecord("ecc_agent_capability");
        eccCapability.get("capability", capability);
        if(gs.nil(eccCapability)) {
            return null;
        }

        var appM2m = new GlideRecord("ecc_agent_application_m2m");
        appM2m.addQuery("application", eccApp.getValue('sys_id'));
        appM2m.query();
        var eligibleAppMids = [];
        while(appM2m.next()) {
            eligibleAppMids.push(appM2m.getValue('agent'));
        }
        if(eligibleAppMids.length == 0) {
            return null;
        }

        var capabilityM2m = new GlideRecord("ecc_agent_capability_m2m");
        capabilityM2m.addQuery("capability", eccCapability.getValue('sys_id'));
        capabilityM2m.query();
        var eligibleCapMids = [];
        while(capabilityM2m.next()) {
            eligibleCapMids.push(capabilityM2m.getValue('agent'));
        }
        if(eligibleCapMids.length == 0) {
            return null;
        }

        var eligibleMids = eligibleAppMids.filter((value) => eligibleCapMids.includes(value));
        if(eligibleMids.length == 0) {
            return null;
        }

        var availableMids = [];
        var eccAgentGr = new GlideRecord("ecc_agent");
        eccAgentGr.addQuery('status', 'up');
        eccAgentGr.addQuery('validated', true);
        eccAgentGr.addQuery('sys_id', 'IN', eligibleMids.join(','));
        eccAgentGr.query();
        while(eccAgentGr.next()) {
            if(eccAgentGr.getValue('sys_domain') == sysDomain) {
                return "mid.server."+eccAgentGr.getValue('name');
            }
            availableMids.push(eccAgentGr);
        }

        gs.info("GenerateCSRProbeInvoker : available and eligible mid " + availableMids[0].getValue('name'));
        return "mid.server." + availableMids[0].getValue('name');
	},

    type: 'GenerateCSRProbeInvoker'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>carlos.paiva@extreme.digital</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-02-23 23:51:04</sys_created_on><sys_id>c8920af43bd3b254be82c237f4e45a02</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>GenerateCSRProbeInvoker</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Certificate Inventory and Management" source="sn_disco_certmgmt">5644310553c63300704dddeeff7b12a5</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Certificate Inventory and Management">5644310553c63300704dddeeff7b12a5</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_c8920af43bd3b254be82c237f4e45a02</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>carlos.paiva@extreme.digital</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-02-23 23:51:04</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
